description: Editable, assumption-driven model for the green-fuel bunkering certification business case. Edit values here, then run: node harness/scripts/business-model.mjs --write. Every input carries a class: verified (a priced meter from the Azure Retail Prices file, or a cited public source), user-provided (a named person and a date), benchmark (a cited public source and retrieval date) or scenario (an illustrative assumption with a rationale). NO input is user-provided today: the case study and the owner supplied no financial figure. Every scenario figure is a placeholder to be replaced from measured data, and the results are not a forecast.
priceRegionNote: Southeast Asia (Singapore) is used only as a representative price point. Prices differ by region (see the price file) and a jurisdiction-local cell may sit in another region or on premises.

opt1.name: Centralised Azure cloud
opt1.likeForLike: Same capability as option 3, but ineligible
opt1.ineligibleReason: Holds delivery measurements from several jurisdictions in one place: violates HC-01 (see DES-0003 option A). Costed only to show the price of sovereignty

opt2.name: Jurisdiction-local edge plus one Azure shore platform
opt2.likeForLike: No: priced as a shore platform plus a local store per port. Calculation and AI over raw evidence would have to run at each port, and that is not priced

opt3.name: Hybrid sovereign evidence cells with federated coordination
opt3.likeForLike: Yes: full platform inside each jurisdiction

references.label: Singapore total bunker sales 2025
references.source: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore statistics as reported by Bunker Market
references.note: Read from the page on the retrieval date. Context for scale only; not used in a calculation.

references.label: Singapore bio-blended bunker sales 2025 (S&P Global figure)
references.source: S&P Global, as returned by a web search on the retrieval date; the article itself was not opened
references.note: The two sources disagree (1.36 against 1.38 million tonnes). The model uses the figure from the page that was actually read.

references.label: Administrative effort saved by digital bunkering across Singapore suppliers (estimate)
references.source: Bunker Market, reporting that all Singapore bunker suppliers had adopted digital bunkering by August 2025
references.note: An estimate quoted by a trade publication for delivery paperwork in general, not for certification. It shows administrative effort in this industry is material; it does not calibrate any hours input here.

inputs.rationale: Illustrative. FR-029 reconstruction replaces document hunting; auditors still need support.

inputs.label: Green-fuel price premium over the conventional equivalent
inputs.rationale: Illustrative. Premiums vary by fuel, blend and month and are not given in the case (D-004, D-034). Replace with the group's invoiced premium.

inputs.label: Share of premium revenue exposed to rejection, discount or claim because evidence is weak, today
inputs.rationale: Illustrative; the largest unmeasured driver in the case. Measure claim and credit-note history first.

inputs.label: Share of premium revenue exposed, with tamper-evident, reproducible evidence
inputs.rationale: Illustrative. Evidence cannot remove commercial or scheme risk, only evidence-driven loss.

inputs.label: Share of a lost premium that falls to profit
inputs.rationale: Illustrative: the feedstock cost is already sunk, so most of a lost premium is lost profit.

inputs.label: Share of premium-at-risk loss that is the same loss as a dispute concession (deducted so it is not counted twice)
inputs.rationale: Illustrative. A disputed delivery can lose its premium and also concede value; without claim and credit-note history the overlap is unknown, so a deliberate share is removed. The report also shows full overlap.

inputs.label: Extra green volume won because auditor-grade evidence is available
inputs.rationale: Illustrative and unproven: customers who only buy with auditable evidence. Zero in the conservative case.

inputs.label: Margin on that extra volume
inputs.rationale: Illustrative; no margin was given.

inputs.label: Memory per replica
inputs.rationale: Small stateless services; a sizing assumption.

inputs.rationale: Assumes a standby billed at the primary's rate; verify against the final configuration.

inputs.label: Database storage per cell
inputs.rationale: Ledger and metadata only; evidence files are in blob storage. A sizing assumption.

inputs.label: Database backup storage per cell
inputs.rationale: Backups stay in the jurisdiction (SEC-001); a sizing assumption.

inputs.label: Evidence stored per delivery (readings, documents, package, certificate)
inputs.rationale: Illustrative; meter sample rates and document sizes are unknown (D-019, D-032). Retention is assumed to exceed three years, so nothing is purged in the horizon.

inputs.label: Premium messaging units per cell
inputs.rationale: A sizing assumption; Premium is assumed because private networking is needed (to be verified in the service matrix).

inputs.label: Managed HSM pools per cell
inputs.rationale: Key custody mechanism is undecided (D-013); one pool for signing keys, a second only if separation is required.

inputs.label: Log and metric ingestion per cell per day
inputs.rationale: A sizing assumption; telemetry must exclude jurisdiction-bound content (SEC-014).

inputs.label: Months of log retention beyond the included period
inputs.rationale: A placeholder for the retention rule (D-016).

inputs.label: Model tokens per cell per year
inputs.rationale: Agents orchestrate, retrieve and draft only; a sizing assumption (D-028).

inputs.label: Blended model price per million tokens
inputs.rationale: Not priced from the list: the model and a deployment type that keeps processing in the jurisdiction are undecided (D-028). The price file shows many model meters are global-scope.

inputs.label: Private networking, DNS, backup and security tooling allowance per cell per month
inputs.rationale: Allowance for items not in the price file (private endpoints, Defender plans, backup vaults); to be estimated when the network design exists.
